original: anye tu sapakṣāvṛttirasādhāraṇaḥ| sapakṣaśca niścitasādhyavān| tathāca śabdo'nityaḥ śabdatvādityādau yadā pakṣe sādhyaniścayastadā nā'sādhāraṇyaṃ, tatra hetorniścayāditi vadanti|
analyzed: anye tu sapakṣa āvṛttiḥ asādhāraṇaḥ sapakṣaḥ ca niścita sādhyavān tathā ca śabdaḥ nityaḥ śabda tvāt ityādau yadā pakṣe sādhya niścayaḥ tadā na asādhāraṇyam tatra hetoḥ niścayāt iti vadanti

original: anupasaṃhārī ca atyantābhāvāpratiyogisādhyakādiḥ| anena vyatirekavyāptijñānapratibandhaḥ kriyate|
analyzed: anupasaṃhārī ca atyanta abhāva apratiyogi sādhyaka ādiḥ anena vyatireka vyāpti jñāna pratibandhaḥ kriyate

original: viruddhastu sādhyavyāpakībhūtābhāvapratiyogī| ayaṃ sādhyābhāvagrahasāmagrītvena pratibandhakaḥ| satpratipakṣe tu pratihetuḥ sādhyābhāvasādhakaḥ atra tu hetureveti viśeṣaḥ|
analyzed: viruddhaḥ tu sādhya vyāpakībhūta abhāva pratiyogī ayam sādhya abhāva graha sāmagrī tvena pratibandhakaḥ satpratipakṣe tu pratihetuḥ sādhya abhāva sādhakaḥ atra tu hetuḥ eva iti viśeṣaḥ

original: sādhyābhāvasādhakaḥ eva hetuḥ sādhyasādhakatvenopanyasta ityaśaktiviśeṣopasthāpakatvācca viśeṣaḥ|
analyzed: sādhya abhāva sādhakaḥ eva hetuḥ sādhya sādhaka tvena upanyastaḥ iti aśakti viśeṣa upasthāpaka tvāt ca viśeṣaḥ

original: satpratipakṣaḥ sādhyābhāvavyāpyavān pakṣaḥ|
analyzed: sat pratipakṣaḥ sādhya abhāva vyāpyavān pakṣaḥ

original: agṛhītāprāmāṇyakasādhyavyāpyavattvopasthitikālīnāgṛhītāprāmāṇyakatadabhāvavyāpya vattvopasthitiviṣayastathetyanye| atra ca parasparābhāvavyāpyavattājñānāt parasparānumitipratibandhaḥphalam|
analyzed: agṛhīta aprāmāṇyaka sādhya vyāpyavat tva upasthiti kālīna agṛhīta aprāmāṇyaka tad abhāva vyāpya vat tva upasthiti viṣayaḥ tathā iti anye atra ca paraspara abhāva vyāpyavat tā jñānāt paraspara anumiti pratibandhaḥ phalam

original: atra kecit| yathā ghaṭābhāvavyāpyavattājñāne'pi ghaṭacakṣuḥsaṃgoge sati ghaṭavattājñānaṃ jāyate, yathā ca śaṅkhe satyapi pītatvābhāvavyāpyaśaṅkhatvavattājñāne sati pittādidoṣe pītaḥ śaṅkha iti dhīḥ, evaṃ koṭidvayavyāpyadarśane'pi koṭidvayasya pratyakṣarūpaḥ saṃśayo bhavati tathā satpratipakṣasthale saṃśayarūpā'numitirbhavatyeva|
analyzed: atra kecid yathā ghaṭa abhāva vyāpya vat tā jñāne api ghaṭa cakṣuḥ saṃgoge sati ghaṭavat tā jñānam jāyate yathā ca śaṅkhe sati api pīta tva abhāva vyāpya śaṅkha tvavat tā jñāne sati pitta ādi doṣe pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ iti dhīḥ evam koṭi dvaya vyāpya darśane api koṭi dvayasya pratyakṣa rūpaḥ saṃśayaḥ bhavati tathā satpratipakṣa sthale saṃśaya rūpa anumitiḥ bhavati eva

original: yatra caikakoṭivyāpyadarśanaṃ tatrā'dhikabalatayā dvitīyakoṭibhānapratibandhānna saṃśayaḥ| phalabalena cā'dhikabalasamabalabhāvaḥ kalpyata ityāhuḥ|
analyzed: yatra ca eka koṭi vyāpya darśanam tatra adhika balatayā dvitīya koṭi bhāna pratibandhāt na saṃśayaḥ phala balena ca adhika bala sama bala bhāvaḥ kalpyate iti āhuḥ

original: tanna| tadabhāvavyāpyavattājñāne sati tadupanītabhānaviśeṣaśābdabodhāderanudayāllaukikasannikarṣājanyadoṣaviśeṣājanyajñānamātre tasya pratibandhakatā, lāghavāt, na tūpanītabhānaviśeṣe śābdabodhe ca pṛthak pratibandhakatā, gauravāt|
analyzed: tat na tad abhāva vyāpyavat tā jñāne sati tad upanīta bhāna viśeṣa śābdabodha ādeḥ anudayāt laukika sannikarṣa ajanya doṣa viśeṣa ajanya jñāna mātre tasya pratibandhaka tā lāghavāt na tu upanīta bhāna viśeṣe śābdabodhe ca pṛthak pratibandhaka tā gauravāt

original: tathā ca pratibandhakasattvāt kathamanumitiḥ? na hi laukikasannikarṣasthale pratyakṣamiva satpratipakṣasthale saṃśayākārā'numitiḥ prāmāṇikī, yenā'numitibhinnatvenā'pi viśeṣaṇīyam| yatra ca koṭidvayavyāpyavattājñānaṃ, tatrobhayatrā'prāmāṇyajñānāt saṃśayaḥ, nā'nyathā, agṛhītāprāmāṇyakasyaiva virodhijñānasya pratibandhakatvāditi|
analyzed: tathā ca pratibandhaka sattvāt katham anumitiḥ na hi laukika sannikarṣa sthale pratyakṣam iva sat pratipakṣa sthale saṃśaya ākārā anumitiḥ prāmāṇikī yena anumiti bhinna tvena api viśeṣaṇīyam yatra ca koṭi dvaya vyāpyavat tā jñānam tatra ubhayatra aprāmāṇya jñānāt saṃśayaḥ na anyathā agṛhīta aprāmāṇyakasya eva virodhi jñānasya pratibandhaka tvāt iti

original: asiddhistu āśrayāsiddhādyanyatamatvam|
analyzed: asiddhiḥ tu āśraya asiddha ādi anyatama tvam

original: āśrayāsiddhiḥ pakṣe pakṣatāvacchedakasyābhāvaḥ, yatra kāñcanamayaḥ parvato bahnimāniti sādhyate, tatra parvato na kāñcanamaya iti jñāne vidyamāne kāñcanamaye parvate parāmarśapratibandhaḥ phalam| taddharmikatadabhāvaniścaye laukikasannikarṣājanyadoṣaviśeṣājanyataddharmikatajjñānamātre virodhīti|
analyzed: āśraya asiddhiḥ pakṣe pakṣa tā avacchedakasya abhāvaḥ yatra kāñcana mayaḥ parvataḥ bahnimān iti sādhyate tatra parvataḥ na kāñcana mayaḥ iti jñāne vidyamāne kāñcana maye parvate parāmarśa pratibandhaḥ phalam tad dharmika tad abhāva niścaye laukika sannikarṣa ajanya doṣa viśeṣa ajanya tad dharmika tad jñāna mātre virodhi iti

original: na tu saṃśayasādhāraṇaṃ pakṣe sādhyasaṃsṛṣṭatvajñānamanumitikāraṇaṃ, tadvirodhitayā ca bādhasatpratipakṣayorhetvābhāvatvamiti yuktam| aprasiddhasādhyakānumityanāpatteḥ, sādhyasaṃśayādikaṃ vinā'pyanumityutpatteśca|
analyzed: na tu saṃśaya sādhāraṇam pakṣe sādhya saṃsṛṣṭa tva jñānam anumiti kāraṇam tad virodhi tayā ca bādha satpratipakṣayoḥ hetvābhāva tvam iti yuktam aprasiddha sādhyaka anumiti anāpatteḥ sādhya saṃśaya ādikam vinā api anumiti utpatteḥ ca

original: evaṃ sādhyābhāvajñāne pramātvajñānamapi na pratibandhakaṃ, mānābhāvāt, gauravācca| anyathā satpratipakṣādāvapi tadabhāvavyāpyavattājñāne pramātvaviṣayakatvena pratibandhakatāpatteḥ, kintu bhramatvajñānānāskanditabādhabuddheḥ pratibandhakatā, tatra bhramatvaśaṅkāvighaṭanena prāmāṇyajñānaṃ kvacidupayujyate|
analyzed: evam sādhya abhāva jñāne pramā tva jñānam api na pratibandhakam māna abhāvāt gauravāt ca anyathā satpratipakṣa ādau api tad abhāva vyāpyavat tā jñāne pramā tva viṣayaka tvena pratibandhaka tā āpatteḥ kintu bhrama tva jñāna anāskandita bādha buddheḥ pratibandhaka tā tatra bhrama tva śaṅkā vighaṭanena prāmāṇya jñānam kvacid upayujyate

original: na ca bādhasthale pakṣe hetusattvevyabhicāraḥ, pakṣe hetvabhāve svarūpāsiddhireva doṣa iti vācyam| bādhajñānasya vyabhicārajñānāderbhedāt|
analyzed: na ca bādha sthale pakṣe hetu sattva ivyabhicāraḥ pakṣe hetu abhāve svarūpa asiddhiḥ eva doṣaḥ iti vācyam bādha jñānasya vyabhicāra jñāna ādeḥ bhedāt

original: kiṃ ca yatra parāmarśānantaraṃ bādhabuddhiḥ, tatra vyabhicārajñānāderakiñcitkaratvātbādhasyā'numitipratibandhakatvaṃ vācyam| evaṃ yatrotpattikṣaṇāvacchinne ghaṭādau gandhavyāpyapṛthivīetvavattājñānaṃ tatra bādhasyaiva pratibandhakatvaṃ vācyam| na ca pakṣe ghaṭe gandhasattvāt kathaṃ bādha iti vācyam|
analyzed: kim ca yatra parāmarśa anantaram bādha buddhiḥ tatra vyabhicāra jñāna ādeḥ akiñcitkaratvāt bādhasya anumiti pratibandhaka tvam vācyam evam yatra utpatti kṣaṇa avacchinne ghaṭa ādau gandha vyāpya pṛthivī etvavat tā jñānam tatra bādhasya eva pratibandhaka tvam vācyam na ca pakṣe ghaṭe gandha sattvāt katham bādhaḥ iti vācyam

original: pakṣatāvacchedakadeśakālāvacchedenā'numiteranubhavasiddhatvāditi|
analyzed: pakṣa tā avacchedaka deśa kāla avacchedena anumiteḥ anubhava siddha tvāt iti

original: bādhatadvyāpyabhinnā ye hetvābhāsāḥ, tadvyāpyā api tanmadhya evāntarbhavanti | anyathā hetvābhāsādhikyaprasaṅgāt| bādhavyāpyasatpratipakṣo bhinna eva, svatantrecchena muninā pṛthagupadeśāt| satpratipakṣavyāpyastu na pratibandhaka iti praghaṭṭakārthaḥ||73||
analyzed: bādha tad vyāpya bhinnāḥ ye hetvābhāsāḥ tad vyāpyāḥ api tad madhye eva antarbhavanti anyathā hetvābhāsa ādhikya prasaṅgāt bādha vyāpya sat pratipakṣaḥ bhinnaḥ eva svatantra icchena muninā pṛthak upadeśāt sat pratipakṣa vyāpyaḥ tu na pratibandhakaḥ iti praghaṭṭaka arthaḥ

original: || iti hetvābhāsasāmānyanirūpaṇam ||
analyzed: iti hetvābhāsa sāmānya nirūpaṇam

original: ādyaḥ sādhāraṇastu syādasādhāraṇako'paraḥ|
analyzed: ādyaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ tu syāt asādhāraṇaka uparaḥ

original: tathaivā'nupasaṃhārī tridhā'naikāntiko bhavet||72||
analyzed: tathā eva anupasaṃhārī tridhā anaikāntikaḥ bhavet

original: yaḥ sapakṣe vipakṣe ca bhavetsādhāraṇastu saḥ|
analyzed: yaḥ sapakṣe vipakṣe ca bhavet sādhāraṇaḥ tu saḥ

original: yastūbhayasmādvayāvṛttaḥ sattvasādhāraṇo mataḥ||73||
analyzed: yaḥ tu ubhayasmāt vayāvṛttaḥ sattva sādhāraṇaḥ mataḥ

original: yaḥ sapakṣa iti| sapakṣavipakṣavṛttiḥ sādhāraṇa ityarthaḥ| sapakṣaḥniścitasādhyavān| vipakṣaḥ -- sādhyavadbhinnaḥ| viruddhavāraṇāya sapakṣavṛttitvamuktam|
analyzed: yaḥ sapakṣaḥ iti sapakṣa vipakṣa vṛttiḥ sādhāraṇaḥ iti arthaḥ sapakṣaḥ niścita sādhyavān vipakṣaḥ sādhyavat bhinnaḥ viruddha vāraṇāya sapakṣa vṛtti tvam uktam

original: vastuto vipakṣavṛttitvameva vācyaṃ, viruddhasya sādhāraṇatve'pi dūṣakatābījasya bhinnatayā tasya pārthakyāt|| iti sādhāraṇanirūpaṇam|
analyzed: vastutas vipakṣa vṛtti tvam eva vācyam viruddhasya sādhāraṇa tve pi dūṣakatā bījasya bhinnatayā tasya pārthakyāt iti sādhāraṇa nirūpaṇam

original: yastūbhayasmāditi| sapakṣavipakṣavyāvṛtta ityarthaḥ| sapakṣaḥ -- sādhyavattayā niścitaḥ| vipakṣaḥ -- sādhyaśūnyatayā niścitaḥ| śabdo'nityaḥ śabdatvādityādau yadā śabde'nityatvasya sandehaḥ, tadā sapakṣatvaṃ vipakṣatvaṃ ca ghaṭādīnāmeva, tadavyāvṛttaṃ ca śabdatvamiti tadā tadasādhāraṇam| yadā tu śabde'anityatvaniścayaḥ, tadā nā'sādhāraṇyam|
analyzed: yaḥ tu ubhayasmāt iti sapakṣa vipakṣa vyāvṛttaḥ iti arthaḥ sapakṣaḥ sādhyavattayā niścitaḥ vipakṣaḥ sādhya śūnyatayā niścitaḥ śabdaḥ nityaḥ śabda tvāt ityādau yadā śabda nitya tvasya sandehaḥ tadā sapakṣa tvam vipakṣa tvam ca ghaṭa ādīnām eva tad avyāvṛttam ca śabda tvam iti tadā tat asādhāraṇam yadā tu śabde anitya tva niścayaḥ tadā na asādhāraṇyam

original: idaṃ tu prācāṃ matam| navīnamataṃ tu pūrvamuktam||72-73|| ityasādhāraṇanirūpaṇam||
analyzed: idam tu prācām matam navīna matam tu pūrvam uktam iti asādhāraṇa nirūpaṇam

original: tathaivā'nupasaṃhārī kevalānvayipakṣakaḥ|
analyzed: tathā eva anupasaṃhārī kevala anvayi pakṣakaḥ

original: kevalānvayīti| sarvamabhidheyaṃ prameyatvādityādau sarvasyaiva pakṣatvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyagrahasthalāntarābhāvānnā'numitiḥ| idaṃ tu na samyak, pakṣaikadeśe sahacāragrahe'pi kṣaterabhāvāt | astu vā sahacārāgrahaḥ, tāvatā'pyajñānarūpā'siddhireva, na tu hetvābhāsatvaṃ tasya, tathā'pi kevalānvayisādhyakatvaṃ tattvamityuktam||
analyzed: kevala anvayi iti sarvam abhidheyam prameya tvāt ityādau sarvasya eva pakṣatvāt sāmānādhikaraṇya graha sthala antara abhāvāt na anumitiḥ idam tu na samyak pakṣa eka deśe sahacāra grahe api kṣateḥ abhāvāt astu vā sahacāra agrahaḥ tāvatā api ajñāna rūpa asiddhiḥ eva na tu hetvābhāsa tvam tasya tathā api kevala anvayi sādhyaka tvam tattvam iti uktam

original: || ityanupasaṃhārinirūpaṇam||
analyzed: iti anupasaṃhāri nirūpaṇam

original: yaḥ sādhyavatīti|
analyzed: yaḥ sādhyavati iti

original: yaḥ sādhyavati naivā'sti sa viruddha udāhṛtaḥ||74||

original: āśrayāsiddhirādyā syāt, svarūpāsiddhirapyatha|
analyzed: āśraya asiddhiḥ ādyā syāt svarūpa asiddhiḥ api atha

original: vyāpyatvāsiddhiraparā syādasiddhiratastridhā||75||
analyzed: vyāpya tva asiddhiḥ aparā syāt asiddhiḥ atas tridhā

original: pakṣāsiddhiryatra pakṣo bhavenmaṇimayo giriḥ|
analyzed: pakṣa asiddhiḥ yatra pakṣaḥ bhavet maṇi mayaḥ giriḥ

original: hrado dravyaṃ dhūmavattvādatrā'siddhirathā'parā||76||
analyzed: hradaḥ dravyam dhūmavat tvāt atra asiddhiḥ atha aparā

original: vyāpyatvāsiddhiraparā nīladhūmādike bhavet|

original: evakāreṇa sādhyavattvāvacchedena hetvabhāvo bodhitaḥ| tathā ca sādhyavyāpakībhūtābhāvapratiyogitvaṃ tadarthaḥ||74||
analyzed: eva kāreṇa sādhyavat tva avacchedena hetvabhāvaḥ bodhitaḥ tathā ca sādhya vyāpakībhūta abhāva pratiyogitvam tad arthaḥ

original: ||iti viruddhanirūpaṇam||
analyzed: iti viruddha nirūpaṇam

original: asidiṃdha vibhajate -- āśrayāsiddhirityādi||75||

original: pakṣāsiddhiriti| āśrayāsiddhirityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pakṣa asiddhiḥ iti āśraya asiddhiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: apareti| svarūpāsiddhirityarthaḥ||76||
analyzed: aparā iti svarūpa asiddhiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nīladhūmādika iti| nīladhūmatvādikaṃ gurutayā na hetutāvacchedakaṃ, svasamānādhikaraṇavyāpyatāvacchedakadharmāntarāghaṭitasyaivavacchadakatvāt vyāpyatāṃ| dhūmaprāgabhāvatvasaṅgrahāya svasamānādhikaraṇeti|| ityasiddhinirūpaṇam||
analyzed: nīla dhūma ādike iti nīla dhūma tva ādikam gurutayā na hetutā avacchedakam sva samāna adhikaraṇa vyāpya tā avacchedaka dharma antara aghaṭitasya eva avacchadaka tvāt vyāpya tām dhūma prāgabhāva tva saṅgrahāya sva samāna adhikaraṇa iti iti asiddhi nirūpaṇam

original: viruddhayoḥ parāmarśe hetvoḥ satpratipakṣatā||77||
analyzed: viruddhayoḥ parāmarśe hetvoḥ sat pratipakṣa tā

original: viruddhayoriti| kapisaṃyogatadabhāvavyāpyavattāparāmarśe'pi na satpratipakṣatvamata uktaṃ viruddhayoriti| tathā ca svasādhryāviruddhasādhyābhāvavyāpyavattāparāmarśakālīnasādhyavyāpyavattāparāmarśaviṣaya ityarthaḥ||77||
analyzed: viruddhayoḥ iti kapi saṃyoga tad abhāva vyāpyavattā parāmarśe api na satpratipakṣatvam atas uktam viruddhayoḥ iti tathā ca sva sādhrya aviruddha sādhya abhāva vyāpyavattā parāmarśa kālīna sādhya vyāpyavattā parāmarśa viṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: sādhyaśūnya iti| pakṣaḥ -- pakṣatāvacchedakaviśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ| tena ghaṭe gandhasatve'pi na kṣatiḥ| evaṃ mūlāvacchinno vṛkṣaḥ kapisaṃyogītyatrā'pi bodhyam||...||
analyzed: sādhya śūnyaḥ iti pakṣaḥ pakṣatā avacchedaka viśiṣṭaḥ iti arthaḥ tena ghaṭe gandha satve api na kṣatiḥ evam mūla avacchinnaḥ vṛkṣaḥ kapi saṃyogī iti atra api bodhyam

original: ||iti bādhamirūpaṇam||
analyzed: iti

original: abhāvapratyakṣasyā''nubhavikatvādanupalambho'pi na pramāṇāntaram| kiñcānupalambhasyājñātasya hetutve jñānākaraṇatvāt pratyakṣatvāt, jñātasya hetutve tu tatprāpyanupalambhāntarāpekṣetyanavasthā||

analyzed: duḥkham nirūpayati adharma iti atha dharma tvena duḥkha tvena kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ pratikūlam iti duḥkha tva jñānāt eva sarveṣām svābhāvika dveṣa viṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ||iti duḥkhanirūpaṇam||

analyzed: icchām nirūpayati nirduḥkha tve iti icchā hi phala viṣayiṇī upāya viṣayiṇī ca phalam tu sukham duḥkha abhāvaḥ ca tatra phala icchām prati phala jñānam kāraṇam atas eva puruṣa arthaḥ sambhavati yat jñātam sat sva vṛttitayā iṣyate sa puruṣa arthaḥ iti tad lakṣaṇāt itara icchā anadhīna icchā viṣaya tvam phalitaḥ ṛthaḥ

original: upāyecchāṃ pratīṣṭasādhanatājñānaṃ kāraṇam|

original: cikīrṣā kṛtisādhyatvaprakārecchā tu yā bhavet|

analyzed: cikīrṣā iti kṛti sādhya viṣayiṇī icchā cikīrṣā pākam kṛtyā sādhayāmi iti tad anubhavāt cikīrṣām prati kṛti sādhya tā jñānam isādhana tā jñānam ca kāraṇam tad hetuḥ iti

original: balavaditi| balavadiddvaṣṭasādhanatājñānaṃ tatra pratibandhakamato madhuviṣasampṛktānnabhojane na cikīrṣā| balavaddveṣaḥ pratibandhaka ityanye|

original: tadahetutveti| balavadaniṣṭājanakatvajñānaṃ tatra kāraṇamityarthaḥ| (kṛtisādhyatājñānādimato balavadaniṣṭasādhanatājñānaśūnyasya balavadaniṣṭājanakatvajñānaṃ vināpi cikīrṣāyāṃ vilambābhāvāt kasyacinmata ityasvaraso darśitaḥ) || 148||
analyzed: tad ahetu tva iti balavat aniṣṭa ajanaka tva jñānam tatra kāraṇam iti arthaḥ kṛti sādhya tā jñāna ādimataḥ balavat aniṣṭa sādhana tā jñāna śūnyasya balavat aniṣṭa ajanaka tva jñānam vinā api cikīrṣāyām vilamba abhāvāt kasyacid mataḥ iti asvarasaḥ darśitaḥ 148

original: ||iti itīcchānirūpaṇam||
analyzed: iti iti icchā nirūpaṇam

original: dveṣaṃ nirūpayati| dviṣṭasādhanateti| duḥkhopāyaviṣayakaṃ dveṣaṃ prati dviṣṭasādhanatājñānaṃ kāraṇamityarthaḥ| balavadiṣṭasādhanatājñānaṃ ca pratibandhakam| tena nāntarīyakaduḥkhajanake pākādau na dveṣaḥ|| iti dveṣanirūpaṇam||
analyzed: dveṣam nirūpayati dviṣṭa sādhanatā iti duḥkha upāya viṣayakam dveṣam prati dviṣṭa sādhanatā jñānam kāraṇam iti arthaḥ balavat iṣṭa sādhanatā jñānam ca pratibandhakam tena nāntarīyaka duḥkha janake pāka ādau na dveṣaḥ iti dveṣa nirūpaṇam

original: kāryatājñānaṃ pravartakamiti guravaḥ| tathāhi -- jñānasya pravṛttau jananīyāyāṃ cikīrṣātiriktaṃ nā'pekṣitamasti| sā ca kṛtisādhyatājñānasādhyā| icchāyāḥ svaprakārakadhīsādhyatvaniyamāt| cikīrṣā hi kṛtisādhyatvaprakārakecchā| tatra kṛtisādhyatvaṃ prakāra| tatprakārakajñānaṃ cikīrṣāyāṃ kāraṇam| taddvārā pravṛttau ca hetuḥ|
analyzed: kārya tā jñānam pravartakam iti guravaḥ tathā hi jñānasya pravṛttau jananīyāyām cikīrṣā atiriktam na apekṣitam asti sā ca kṛti sādhya tā jñāna sādhyā icchāyāḥ sva prakāraka dhī sādhya tva niyamāt cikīrṣā hi kṛti sādhya tva prakāraka icchā tatra kṛti sādhya tvam prakāra tad prakāraka jñānam cikīrṣāyām kāraṇam tad dvārā pravṛttau ca hetuḥ

original: na tviṣṭasādhanatājñānaṃ tatra hetuḥ| nitye tadabhāvāt| kṛtyasādhye'pi pravṛttyāpatteḥ| kṛtyasādhyatājñānaṃ pratibandhakamiti cenna| tadabhāvāpekṣayā kṛtisādhyatājñānasya laghutvāt| na ca dvayoreva hetutvam, gauravāt nanu tvanmate'pi madhuviṣasampṛktānnabhojane caityavandane ca pravṛttyāpattiḥ, kāryatājñānasattvāditi cenna|
analyzed: na tu iṣṭasādhanatā jñānam tatra hetuḥ nitye tad abhāvāt kṛtya sādhye api pravṛtti āpatteḥ kṛtya sādhya tā jñānam pratibandhakam iti ced na tad abhāva apekṣayā kṛti sādhya tā jñānasya laghu tvāt na ca dvayoḥ eva hetu tvam gauravāt nanu tvad mate api madhu viṣa sampṛkta anna bhojane caitya vandane ca pravṛtti āpattiḥ kārya tā jñāna sattvāt iti ced na

original: svaviśeṣaṇavattāpratisandhā najanyakāryatājñānasya pravartakatvāt| kāmye hi yāgapākādau kāmanā svaviśeṣaṇam| tataśca balavadaniṣṭānanubandhikāmyasādhanatājñānena kāryatājñānam, tataḥ pravṛttiḥ |

original: tṛptaśca bhojane na pravartatee, tadānīṃ kāmanāyāḥ puruṣaviśeṣaṇatvābhāvāt| nitye śaucādikaṃ puruṣaviśeṣaṇam, tena śaucādijñānādhīnakṛtisādhyatājñānāttatra pravṛttiḥ| nanu tadapekṣayāṃ lāghavena balavadaniṣṭānanubandhīṣṭasādhanatājñānaviśiṣṭakāryatājñānameva heturastu|
analyzed: tṛptaḥ ca bhojane na tadānīm kāmanāyāḥ puruṣa viśeṣaṇa tva abhāvāt nitye śauca ādikam puruṣa viśeṣaṇam tena śauca ādi jñāna adhīna kṛti sādhya tā jñānāt tatra pravṛttiḥ nanu tad apekṣayām lāghavena balavat aniṣṭa ananubandhi iṣṭasādhanatā jñāna viśiṣṭa kāryatā jñānam eva hetuḥ astu

original: balavadaniṣṭānanubandhitvaṃ ceṣṭotpattināntarīyakaduḥ khādhikaduḥkhājanakatvam, balavaddveṣaviṣayaduḥkhājanakatvaṃ veti cenna| iṣṭasādhanatvakṛti sādhyatvayoryugapajjñātumaśakyatvāt, sādhyatvasādhanatvayorvirodhāt| asiddhasya hi sādhyatvaṃ siddhasya ca sādhanatvam| na caikamekenaikadā siddhamasiddhaṃ ca jñāyate|
analyzed: balavat aniṣṭa ananubandhi tvam ceṣṭā utpatti nāntarīyaka duḥ kha adhika duḥkha ajanaka tvam balavat dveṣa viṣaya duḥkha ajanaka tvam vā iti ced na iṣṭasādhana tva kṛti sādhya tvayoḥ yugapad jñātum aśakya tvāt sādhya tva sādhana tvayoḥ virodhāt asiddhasya hi sādhya tvam siddhasya ca sādhana tvam na ca ekam ekena ekadā siddham asiddham ca jñāyate

original: tasmāt kālabhedādubhayaṃ jñāyata iti|
analyzed: tasmāt kāla bhedāt ubhayam jñāyate iti

original: maivam| lāghavena balavadaniṣṭānanubandhīṣṭasādhanatve sati kṛtisādhyatājñānasya hetutvāt| na ca sādhyatvasādhanatvayorvirodhaḥ| yadākadācit sādhyatvasādhanatvayoravirodhāt,
analyzed: mā evam lāghavena balavat aniṣṭa ananubandhi iṣṭasādhanatve sati kṛti sādhya tā jñānasya hetutvāt na ca sādhyatva sādhanatvayoḥ virodhaḥ yadā kadācid sādhyatva sādhanatvayoḥ avirodhāt

original: ekadā sādhyatvasādhanatvayoścā'jñānāt| navyāstu, mamedaṃ kṛtisādhyamiti jñānaṃ na pravarrtakam, anāgate tasya jñātumaśakyatvāt| kintu yādṛśasya puṃsaḥ kṛtisādhyaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ tādṛśatvaṃ svasya pratisandhāya tatra pravarrtate| tenaudanakāmasya tatsādhanatājñānavatastadupakaraṇavataḥ pākaḥ kṛtisādhyastādṛśaścāhamiti pratisandhāya pāke pravṛttirityāhuḥ|
analyzed: ekadā sādhya tva sādhana tvayoḥ ca ajñānāt navyāḥ tu mama idam kṛti sādhyam iti jñānam na pravarrtakam anāgate tasya jñātum aśakya tvāt kintu yādṛśasya puṃsaḥ kṛti sādhyam yat dṛṣṭam tādṛśa tvam svasya pratisandhāya tatra pravarrtate tena odana kāmasya tad sādhana tā jñānavataḥ tad upakaraṇavataḥ pākaḥ kṛti sādhyaḥ tādṛśaḥ ca aham iti pratisandhāya pāke pravṛttiḥ iti āhuḥ

original: tanna, svakalpitalipyādipravṛttau yauvane kāmodbhedādinā sambhogādau ca pravṛttau tadabhāvāt|

original: idaṃ tu bodhyam| idānīntaneṣṭasādhanatvādijñānaṃ pravarrtakaṃ, tena bhāviyauvarājye bālasya na pravṛttiḥ tadānīṃ kṛtisādhyatvājñānāt| evaṃ tṛpto bhojane na pravartate,
analyzed: idam tu bodhyam idānīntana iṣṭa sādhana tva ādi jñānam pravarrtakam tena bhāvi yauvarājye bālasya na pravṛttiḥ tadānīm kṛti sādhya tva ajñānāt evam tṛptaḥ bhojane na pravartate

original: tadānīmiṣṭasādhanatvājñānāt| pravartate ca roṣadūṣitacitto viṣādibhakṣaṇe, tadānīṃ balavaniṣṭānanubandhitvajñānāt| na cā''stikasyā'gamyāgamane śatruvadhādipravṛttau ca kathaṃ balavadaniṣṭānanubandhitvabuddhiḥ? narakasādhanatvajñānāditi vācyam| utkaṭarāgādinā narakasādhanatādhītirodhānāt| vṛṣṭyādau tu kṛtisādhyatājñānābhāvānna cikīrṣāpravṛttī|
analyzed: tadānīm iṣṭa sādhana tva ajñānāt pravartate ca roṣa dūṣita cittaḥ viṣa ādi bhakṣaṇe tadānīm balavat iṣṭa ananubandhi tva jñānāt na ca āstikasya agamyā gamane śatru vadha ādi pravṛttau ca katham balavat aniṣṭa ananubandhi tva buddhiḥ naraka sādhana tva jñānāt iti vācyam utkaṭa rāga ādinā naraka sādhana tā dhī tirodhānāt vṛṣṭi ādau tu kṛti sādhya tā jñāna abhāvāt na cikīrṣā pravṛttī

original: kintviṣṭasādhanatājñānādicchāmātram| kṛtiśca pravṛttirūpā bodhyā| tena jīvanayoniyannasādhye prāṇapañcakasañcāre na pravṛttiḥ|
analyzed: kintu iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānāt icchā mātram kṛtiḥ ca pravṛtti rūpā bodhyā tena jīvana yoni yanna sādhye prāṇapañcaka sañcāre na pravṛttiḥ

original: itthaṃ ca pravartakatvānurodhādvidherapīṣṭasādhanatvādikamevā'rthaḥ| itthaṃ ca viśvajitā yajetetyādau yatra phalaṃ na śrūyate, tatrāpi svargaḥ phalaṃ kalpyate |
